Behind the image
31 / Whiteout
REFERENCE 5789.JPG / EDITORIAL PAGE 025
Art direction: Extreme-weather beauty, cobalt blue shadows, raw texture, dynamic motion streaks.
Dramatic photorealistic extreme close-up portrait of an original adult East Asian woman in a
snowstorm, wearing a black chunky textured knit bucket hat and matching knit scarf, both crusted
with fresh snow clumps, with long dark strands of hair blowing across her face. Cold-flushed rosy
cheeks with snowflakes on her skin, intense direct gaze and slightly parted muted-mauve lips.
Streaks of falling snow in horizontal motion blur crossing the frame, deep cobalt blue color cast,
high-contrast cold daylight, shallow depth of field, ultra-detailed skin and knit texture,
extreme-weather fashion editorial, no text or logos.
32 / Ivory Fur
REFERENCE 5788.JPG / EDITORIAL PAGE 026
Art direction: Siberian-inspired winter beauty, soft sky-blue background, texture contrast between
fur and sleek hair.
Photorealistic vertical beauty portrait, shot from a slightly low angle, of an original adult East Asian
woman with long, straight black hair blowing loosely across her face, wearing a large, voluminous
cream and tan faux-fur hat pulled down to her brows and a black fuzzy high-neck sweater. Dark
berry-brown matte lips, dark eyes with a calm, distant gaze. Pale overcast white-blue sky
background, soft diffused cold daylight, muted desaturated palette, detailed fur and hair texture,
analog film grain, minimalist winter editorial, no text or logos.
